architecture.mechanism: Composition-structure-property relationships in proton-conducting electrolytes to control proton transport and chemical stability.
architecture.intervention: Synthesize a composite seal material incorporating a doped perovskite proton-conducting ceramic phase identified in the paper to manage hydrogen diffusion and maintain structural integrity at -40C without external heating.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of seal embrittlement and freeze-lock by regulating proton uptake and preventing hydride formation within the seal matrix during rapid 70MPa dispensing.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the composite seal to 10,000 cycles of rapid depressurization from 70MPa at -40C and measure leakage rates; failure is confirmed if leakage exceeds 1x10^-6 mbar·L/s or if microscopic cracking indicative of embrittlement is observed.
